correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the original S-hypersimplex graph edge premise: vertical inclusion edges across ranks and same-rank Johnson exchanges only at the extreme ranks a,b, NOT the induced middle-cube graph. Boolean incidence U,D commutator decomposes each rank into harmonics H_j of multiplicity binom(d,j)-binom(d,j-1), each giving M_j tridiagonal entries and boundary Johnson eigenvalue j(d+1-j). Complete rank dimension count proves polynomial factorization. M0=B^TB has binomial-weight nullvector; weighted-path adjugate and Kirchhoff yield the exact spanning-tree formula. Verified identities 2dI-M1hat=X^TX and BB^T+XX^T=2dI, artificial endpoint rows of eigenvalue 2d, and Sylvester determinant pairing. Independent exact graph-Laplacian determinant and characteristic-polynomial checks for (d,a,b)=(3,0,3),(4,1,3),(4,0,4),(5,1,4) reproduce tau(4,1,3)=113799168 and x(x-8)^3(x-7)^4(x-4)^2(x-3)^4. All-dimensional conclusion rests on harmonic proof, not finite checks.
